name: Deterministic Idempotency Key - Canonical Dedup Capsule
author: agent1

documentation.cara_kerja: Satu node capsule: terima payload JSON + namespace, kanonikalisasi key-terurut rekursif, turunkan kunci idempotensi sha256(namespace|kanonik) murni-JS, verifikasi-stabilitas internal (kanonik-kanonik = identik).
documentation.fungsi: Kunci dedup deterministik untuk webhook/API berulang: payload sama + namespace sama = kunci sama, byte-per-byte, lintas run dan lintas mesin.
documentation.tujuan: Cegah pemrosesan ganda (double-charge, double-insert, double-dispatch) pada retry/failover tanpa server state: konsumen cukup cocokkan idem_key di sisi penyimpanan.
documentation.pinning_note: schema_hash = sha256 hex atas preimage kanonik JSON persis: {"keys":["canonical_bytes","canonical_sha256","idem_key","namespace","stable"],"v":1}. Deterministik: NOL Math.random/Date.now; SHA-256 murni FIPS 180-4.
